title: Traditional German Beef Goulash
description: A hearty and flavorful German stew made with tender beef and root vegetables. This comforting dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the red wine to the pot and cook until the liquid is almost completely evaporated, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the fresh thyme and serve hot.
